class.name: NetwInterpolate
class.brief_description: How a received value is smoothed before it is shown.
class.description: Received values are interpolated into the property [member target]. [codeblock] Netw.configure_property(self, &"position").interpolate( NetwInterpolate.new().lerp().smooth(0.05).to(&"position") ) [/codeblock] It works the same with [method Netw.configure_property], [method Netw.configure_rpc] and [method Netw.configure_signal]. When [member NetwDisplayHandle.visual_root] is set, values are written in global space. Add a second [NetwInterpolate] to also smooth [code]rotation[/code].

method.name: hold
method.description: Sets [member forecast_tail] to [constant TAIL_HOLD], for values that must not be guessed ahead, such as flags.

method.name: is_same_spec
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when [param other] has the same settings.

method.name: project_by
method.description: Sets [member project_channel], the velocity used to guess ahead.

method.name: smoothing_weight
method.description: How far one frame of [param frame_delta] seconds moves toward the target, given [member smoothing]. The result looks the same at any frame rate.

members.member: Whether the value is guessed ahead with [constant NetwMultiplayer.TIMELINE_MODE_FORECAST].
Another synchronized property holding this value's velocity, used to guess ahead. When empty, the velocity is computed from the last two values.
A change larger than this jumps instead of interpolating. [code]0.0[/code] never jumps.
The property that receives the smoothed value. When empty, [method Netw.configure_property] uses its own property. Always set it for RPC and signal arguments.

constants.constant: Guess ahead from the velocity, up to [constant NetwMultiplayer.DISPLAY_PARAM_MAX_FORECAST_TICKS].
Keep the newest value and never guess ahead.
